title: SurgiCLAW: An Interpretable Atomic-Skill Agent for Precision Robotic Micromanipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and vision--language--action models have provided robots with new capabilities for long-horizon task understanding and planning. In surgical robotics, however, end-to-end prediction of low-level actions remains limited by insufficient precision, opaque decisions, and scarce data. This paper presents SurgiCLAW, a hierarchical skill-based framework for precision surgical manipulation. SurgiCLAW confines an MLLM to intraoperative visual understanding, structured explanation, and atomic surgical-skill selection, while delegating physical execution to verifiable deterministic control programs. For brain--machine-interface implantation, a representative high-precision surgical task, we construct a state-to-skill invocation dataset and expand it through visual and state perturbations. translated_title: SurgiCLAW：一个用于精准机器人微操作的可解释原子技能智能体
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和视觉-语言-动作模型为机器人带来了长程任务理解与规划的新能力。然而在手术机器人领域，端到端的底层动作预测仍受限于精度不足、决策不透明以及数据稀缺。本文提出了SurgiCLAW，一个面向精准手术操作的分层技能框架。SurgiCLAW将多模态大语言模型限定于术中视觉理解、结构化解释和原子手术技能选择，而将物理执行委托给可验证的确定性控制程序。针对脑机接口植入这一代表性的高精度手术任务，我们构建了状态到技能调用的数据集，并通过视觉和状态扰动对其进行扩充。该模型首先通过监督微调学习结构化的技能调用，随后利用……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SurgiCLAW分层技能框架，让多模态大语言模型专注于术中视觉理解、结构化解释与原子技能选择，同时将物理执行交由可验证的确定性控制程序完成，实现了精准且可解释的机器人手术微操作。
en_tdlr: SurgiCLAW is a hierarchical skill-based framework that confines MLLMs to intraoperative visual understanding, structured explanation, and atomic skill selection while delegating execution to verifiable deterministic control programs, enabling interpretable and precise robotic micromanipulation for high-precision surgical tasks such as brain-machine-interface implantation.
